exams.name: Registered Municipal Accountant Examination
exams.quote: A certified public accountant or public accountant holding an active license shall qualify as a registered municipal accountant by passing a registered municipal accountant's examination

interval_years.quote: The registration fee for a registered municipal accountant of New Jersey shall be established by the board, and shall be imposed for each triennial registration

required.quote: The board shall require any person licensed as a registered municipal accountant, as a condition for triennial licensure, to complete the required number of credits of continuing professional education as determined by the board during each triennial period of licensure

period_years.quote: during each triennial period of licensure

exists.quote: the New Jersey State Board of Accountancy

regulatory_model.quote: The board shall only grant or renew registration to a firm engaged in the practice of attest services or public accountancy if that firm meets the requirements provided in this section

credential_type.quote: A firm shall register with the board if it: (a) Has an office in this State engaged in the practice of attest services

is_mandatory.quote: A firm shall register with the board if it: (a) Has an office in this State engaged in the practice of attest services; (b) Has an office in this State that uses the title "Certified Public Accountant," "CPA," "Certified Public Accountant firm," or "CPA firm;" or (c) Does not have an office in this State, but offers or renders attest services

title_protection.quote: A firm which is so registered may use the words "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPAs" in connection with its firm name

scope_protection.quote: A firm shall register with the board if it: (a) Has an office in this State engaged in the practice of attest services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board or is of a nature such that certification, registration or licensure of the person would be inconsistent with the public's health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

attest_services_types.quote: the practice of attest services, as defined in section 3 of P.L.1997, c.259 (C.45:2B-44)

compilation_services_authorized.quote: A firm that is not subject to the requirements of paragraph (1) of this subsection may perform compilation services and professional services other than attest services while using the title "Certified Public Accountant," "CPA," "Certified Public Account firm," or "CPA firm," without registering with the board

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: A firm shall register with the board if it: (a) Has an office in this State engaged in the practice of attest services

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of a firm, in terms of financial interest and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, shall belong to certified public accountants of any state or possession of the United States or the District of Columbia in good standing, and licensed to practice public accountancy where licensed

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Other than a nonlicensee owner, any partner, officer, shareholder, member, or manager whose principal place of business is in this State shall be a certified public accountant in good standing

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: Does not have an office in this State, but offers or renders attest services, as defined in section 3 of P.L.1997, c.259 (C.45:2B-44), unless it meets each of the following requirements

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: There shall be a certified public accountant in the firm who has ultimate responsibility for each attest engagement. On all firm applications and renewal forms, a licensee or an individual who qualifies for the practice privilege under section 6 of P.L.2008, c.45 (C.45:2B-50.1) shall be designated as responsible and in charge of all professional matters relating to the practice of accountancy by the registered firm

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm shall register with the board if it: (a) Has an office in this State engaged in the practice of attest services

registered_municipal_accountant_designat.quote: A certified public accountant or public accountant holding an active license shall qualify as a registered municipal accountant by passing a registered municipal accountant's examination. Only a registered municipal accountant licensed in this State shall undertake the work of auditing the financial statements of any municipality or county

public_school_accountant_designation.quote: Any person who undertakes the work of auditing the financial statements of any school district in New Jersey shall qualify as a public school accountant (PSA) by: a. Submitting an application to the board, demonstrating satisfactorily to the board that the individual holds an active license in New Jersey as a certified public accountant, public accountant, or registered municipal accountant

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: A firm engaged in this State in the practice of attest services and not otherwise registered with the board or exempt from registration under section 13 of P.L.1997, c.259 (C.45:2B-54) shall be required to register with the board as a firm of public accountants
